title: Silicon GW Band Gap: Reduced-Order Reproducibility Audit
summary: Implement a pinned two-band quasiparticle model on the visible silicon primitive cell, produce auditable mean-field and GW artifacts, and generalize the solver to a hidden valley/grid case.
taskPrompt: Read base/input/problem_spec.md and base/input/model_spec.json. Use base/software/python with no network. Parse the silicon POSCAR and UPF, evaluate the specified mean-field and GW surrogate on the exact k grid, create the intermediate and final JSON/CSV diagnostics, and include a generic executable solve.py. Write exactly base/output/mean_field.json, base/output/quasiparticle.json, base/output/band_path.csv, and base/output/diagnostics.json plus solve.py; the evaluator runs solve.py on an evaluator-only case with a different grid and valley.
agentMustDo: Validate the two-atom diamond primitive structure
Compute the complete half-open k-grid and independent GW correction
Provide a generic solve.py accepting CASE.json RESULT.json
evaluation: Hard gates reject missing/extra files, malformed JSON/CSV, wrong units, non-executable solve.py, invalid coordinates, or writes outside output. Score: 0.20 visible mean-field extrema/gap, 0.20 visible QP gap/opening and topology, 0.15 band-path shape, 0.10 diagnostics/invariants, 0.35 hidden generic solve.py execution on a different grid and valley. Numeric tolerances are 1e-8 eV for scalar references and 2e-6 eV RMSE for path values. Empty/malformed submissions return [0.0].
